method: Automated inventory read every source, evidence, pathway, profile and review record in the exact manifest candidate for this ISO.

Automated screening compared source references, locators, geography fields, evidence class, direction, status, horizon and scenario; it checked pathway support IDs, link-evidence sets, geography fields, alternatives and uncertainty for follow-up.

Raw extraction access rows are recorded only as inherited access observations. This generated screen does not treat snippets, HTTP success, prior access, or metadata as claim verification and does not replace semantic source review.

pathways.compact_statement: Yagi damaged WASH; longer water journeys increased girls' reported GBV exposure, not confirmed incidents.
alternative_explanations: Pre-existing water-service gaps and protection inequalities shaped risk.
pathways.uncertainty: Agency-reported protection risk; no causal attribution study, incidence estimate or anthropogenic attribution of Yagi.
recommendations: No structural linkage issue identified; review each cited passage for its specific causal link, alternatives and uncertainty before treating the pathway as verified.

pathways.compact_statement: Yagi-related livelihood loss compounded northern household hardship and potential trafficking risk; no incidents are attributed.
alternative_explanations: Pre-existing poverty, remoteness and trafficking risks also matter.
pathways.uncertainty: Dated interagency planning diagnosis, not measured post-event trafficking or ethnic-group risk propensity.
recommendations: Retain only evidence whose documented geography supports the pathway location; otherwise narrow the pathway or keep the evidence standalone.
